newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hoogovens sees strong 1997 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens sees strong 1997 profit rise.

text.p: Steel and aluminium group Hoogovens NV said on Wednesday it expected 1997 net profits to show a strong increase.
"On the basis of our prospects and barring unforeseen circumstances, we expect a strong increase in the net profit for the whole of 1997 compared with 1996," the company said.
Earlier Hoogovens reported a 40 percent rise in first-half net profit to 194 million guilders.
It said high sales and an improved product mix for both steel and aluminium had been achieved during the first six months of the year.
"The positive performance of the economy will be sustained in the second half of the year, thereby creating room for an increase in prices," Hoogovens said.
